manifest_security.title: Application Data Backup Allowed
manifest_security.description: android:allowBackup is true (or not set, defaulting to true). Any user or attacker with USB access can extract the full app data directory using 'adb backup' without root. Set to false or use android:fullBackupOnly with a proper backup rule.

manifest_security.title: Exported Provider Without Permission
manifest_security.description: The provider 'SuggestionsProvider' is exported (accessible from other apps) but has no android:permission protection. Any app on the device can start, bind, or send data to it without restriction.

manifest_security.title: Exported Provider Without Permission
manifest_security.description: The provider 'TempFileProvider' is exported (accessible from other apps) but has no android:permission protection. Any app on the device can start, bind, or send data to it without restriction.

manifest_security.title: Low Minimum SDK Version (19)
manifest_security.description: minSdkVersion=19 targets Android versions that lack modern security controls (full-disk encryption, SELinux enforcement, runtime permissions). Minimum recommended is 21 (Android 5.0).

manifest_security.title: Low Target SDK Version (19)
manifest_security.description: targetSdkVersion=19 opts out of security improvements introduced in Android 9+ (Pie), including default HTTPS enforcement, restricted access to device identifiers, and background restrictions. Target SDK 28 or higher is strongly recommended.

manifest_security.title: Deep Link Activity Without Permission
manifest_security.description: Activity '.ui.ComposeMessageActivity' handles custom deep link scheme 'sms://'. Any app or web page can launch this activity with arbitrary intent data. Validate all incoming URI parameters before use.
